# Raúl Ripollés García

> Consultor HIS/QA e implantador en el sector sanitario. Desarrollo web y apps (Flutter). Valencia / Madrid · Remoto.

## Who

- Name: Raúl Ripollés García
- Role: HIS consultant, QA implementer, web/app developer
- Location: Valencia / Madrid, Spain (remote-friendly)
- Languages: Spanish (native), Valencian B1, English B1

## Specialties

- Hospital Information Systems (HIS) implementation
- Healthcare IT: SQL Server, high-availability environments, HL7/Mirth
- Parameterization and N2/N3 support for clinical systems
- Web development and Flutter apps
- WordPress plugins and Laravel admin panels

## Experience highlights

- Tich Consulting (ASISA Group): Database consultant / parameterization for 200+ healthcare centers
- Laberit: HIS implementer (IVO, HCB Benidorm) — training, functional tests, HL7
- Sothis: Clinical software rollout across 8 hospitals in Comunidad Valenciana

## Projects

- Pills: Flutter health app (medications, vitals, clinical diary)
- Ladmin Panel: Laravel admin (tickets, appointments, clock-in, CRM, marketing)
- AnswerLift: WordPress plugin for SEO, GEO (llms.txt) and AEO
- Virtual Assistant WordPress: voice assistant with AI providers
